description: Full details (same fields as get_venue) for up to 50 venues or places in one call, e.g. every stop of an itinerary. Pass ids and/or slugs from previous results; duplicates are fetched once. Results keep the order you passed (ids first, then slugs); anything not found is listed in not_found instead of failing the call.

ids.description: Node IDs from other tools' results.

slugs.description: Evendo slug paths, if you have them instead of IDs.

name: get_venues
title: Get details for several venues
